focus: the two-layer gun shield in Building_WeaponMount.DrawShield and MountExtension
diffSource: since build 11 (2026-10-14T03:57:26Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: shieldFrontTexPath names a texture that does not exist: error on first draw and a magenta square over the gun
findings.detail: MW_GunEmplacement sets shieldFrontTexPath to Things/Building/Security/MW_GunShield_Front, but there is no such PNG anywhere in the mod. The only *GunShield* file is Textures/Things/Building/Security/MW_GunShield.png, and the diff adds no _Front file. MakeShieldGraphic calls GraphicDatabase.Get<Graphic_Single>, and Graphic_Single.Init calls ContentFinder<Texture2D>.Get(req.path) with failure reporting on. So the first armored emplacement drawn with a weapon logs 'Could not load Texture2D', and from then on the front layer draws as the missing-texture square at +1 altitude step, over the barrel. Add Textures/Things/Building/Security/MW_GunShield_Front.png on the same canvas as MW_GunShield.png, or remove line 131 until the art exists.

findings.title: Making MW_GunEmplacement stuffable logs a load error for every emplacement already in a save
findings.detail: The def had no stuffCategories before and now takes Stony/Metallic. When an old save loads, Thing.ExposeData at PostLoadInit sees def.MadeFromStuff && Stuff == null and calls Log.Error('… is made from stuff but has no stuff set. Setting default stuff.') once per built emplacement, then fixes it. The save loads, but players see red errors. One fix: in Building_WeaponMount.ExposeData, after base.ExposeData(), when Scribe.mode == LoadSaveMode.LoadingVars and def.MadeFromStuff && Stuff == null, call SetStuffDirect(GenStuff.DefaultStuffFor(def)), so the vanilla check at PostLoadInit finds stuff already set. Otherwise, say in the changelog that the error is expected and harmless.

findings.title: MW_GunEmplacement.png is now an unused texture that still ships
findings.detail: The emplacement's texPath moved to Things/Building/Linked/MW_ArmoredMount_Atlas, and nothing in Defs or Source references Things/Building/Security/MW_GunEmplacement any more (a grep for it only finds the defName). The diff already deleted the unused MW_WeaponMountReinforced.png, so this one can go the same way.

findings.title: The spray-verb comment names the wrong class
findings.detail: The comment cites Fortified.Verb_ArcSprayProjectile. The installed Dead Man's Switch declares DMS.Verb_ArcSprayProjectile : Verb_ArcSpray, and vanilla has its own Verse.Verb_ArcSprayProjectile. The IsAssignableFrom(Verb_Spray) + defaultProjectile check covers both, so only the comment is wrong.

findings.title: Spray weapons will not visibly sweep: the gun and shield are drawn at Top.CurRotation, not AimAngleOverride
findings.detail: Verb_Spray.AimAngleOverride gives the angle to each path cell during a burst, and vanilla TurretTop.DrawTurret uses it. Building_WeaponMount.DrawAt uses Top.CurRotation for both DrawEquipmentAiming and DrawShield, so a mounted gatling's art and shield stay still while its shots sweep. Using `CurrentEffectiveVerb?.AimAngleOverride ?? Top.CurRotation` for `aim` in DrawAt would match vanilla. Cosmetic only.
